chapter: Sue and Patsy Howard in show business
title: When it happened and the house band
summary: Patsy dates the Cohen episode around 1942-43; Chris Columbus led the house band.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: At the time that he was running The Rum Boogie, did he have a bigger reputation as he did later.
I think he did, I am not sure.

That was like in '42. '41 or '42, around in there. Or '43, because shortly after that, I think we received our money from the labor union in September and in that very same month, that's when I left to go to New York, and that was in '43, '44 really.
While you all were still there I went in the service.
They had their own house band. Chris Columbus, who is the father of Sonny Payne, he had the orchestra there at that time.
